description: NGC 3311's starlight as a volume: the survey image with the Milky Way stars removed (NOX) and neighbouring galaxies masked (NGC 3309 among them), its light along each sight line spread in depth by the deprojected density of Arnaboldi et al.'s Sérsic fit, on an oblate spheroid about NGC 3311's minor axis in the plane of the sky. Depth follows that stated shape; it is not measured.
